compat.text: Sikaflex®-400 Fire is designed for fire rated movement and connection joints and penetrations on porous and non-porous substrates.
compat.heading: USES

compat.text: Do not use on natural stone.
compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

compat.text: Do not use on bituminous substrates, natural rubber, EPDM rubber or on any building materials which might leach oils, plasticisers or solvents that could degrade the sealant.
compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

compat.text: Do not use to seal joints in and around swimming pools.
compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

compat.text: Do not use for joints under water pressure or permanent water immersion.
compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

compat.text: Apply Sika® Primer-3 N applied by brush
compat.heading: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION

compat.text: Before sealing, allow a waiting time of > 30 minutes (< 8 hours) Porous substrates Concrete, aerated concrete and cement based renders, mortars and bricks surfaces must be primed using Sika® Primer-3 N or Sika® Primer-210 applied by brush
compat.heading: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION

classification.hazard_class: Specific target organ toxicity - repeated exposure (Oral)
classification.text: Specific target organ toxicity - repeated exposure (Oral) : Category 2

hazard_statements.statement: May cause damage to organs through prolonged or repeated exposure if swallowed.
hazard_statements.text: H373 May cause damage to organs through prolonged or repeated exposure if swallowed.

precautionary_statements.statement: Do not breathe mist or vapours.
precautionary_statements.text: P260 Do not breathe mist or vapours.

precautionary_statements.statement: Get medical advice/ attention if you feel unwell.
precautionary_statements.text: P314 Get medical advice/ attention if you feel unwell.

precautionary_statements.statement: Dispose of contents/ container to an approved waste disposal plant.
precautionary_statements.text: P501 Dispose of contents/ container to an approved waste disposal plant.

storage.label: Conditions for safe storage
storage.text: Keep container tightly closed in a dry and well-ventilated place. Store in accordance with local regulations.

handling.label: Advice on protection against fire and explosion
handling.text: Normal measures for preventive fire protection.

handling.label: Advice on safe handling
handling.text: Avoid exceeding the given occupational exposure limits (see section 8). For personal protection see section 8. Smoking, eating and drinking should be prohibited in the application area. Follow standard hygiene measures when handling chemical products

handling.label: Hygiene measures
handling.text: Handle in accordance with good industrial hygiene and safety practice. When using do not eat or drink. When using do not smoke. Wash hands before breaks and at the end of workday.

respiratory.label: Respiratory protection
respiratory.text: In case of inadequate ventilation wear respiratory protection. Respirator selection must be based on known or anticipated exposure levels, the hazards of the product and the safe working limits of the selected respirator.

hands.label: Hand protection
hands.text: Chemical-resistant, impervious gloves complying with an approved standard should be worn at all times when handling chemical products if a risk assessment indicates this is necessary. Follow AS/NZS 1337.1 Recommended: Butyl rubber/nitrile rubber gloves. Contaminated gloves should be removed.

skin_body.label: Skin and body protection
skin_body.text: Protective clothing (e.g. safety shoes, long-sleeved working clothing, long trousers) Follow AS 2210:3

engineering_controls.label: Appropriate engineering controls
engineering_controls.text: Use adequate ventilation and/or engineering controls to prevent exposure to vapours.
